After the revision conflict, re-read the presentation, apply that same intended content at the current revision with the new key “review-v041-title-test-b”, then repeat that exact successful request once with the same key to verify idempotent replay. Re-read the final state. End with exactly these five labeled lines:

Committed revision:
Replay revision:
Total revision advance:
Final content:

Receive revision_conflict from update_element_identity at expected revision 0 without mutation
Re-read, call update_element_identity at revision 1 with the new key, then replay the exact successful request with the same key
